recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Q3 2026 Earnings Call: Diamond Green Diesel Renewable Fuel Sales Recovery
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported Q3 2026 results with net income surging to $267 million as renewable fuel margins recovered. Diamond Green Diesel sold 314.9 million gallons of renewable fuel in Q3, totaling 936.1 million gallons for the first nine months of 2026, with a short-term hydrogen outage in Louisiana reducing output by approximately 20 million gallons.

recent_news.headline: Clean Harbors Tops Q3 2026 Estimates and Lifts Outlook
recent_news.summary: Clean Harbors beat Wall Street's third-quarter expectations with earnings of $3.93 a share on revenue of $1.87 billion, and raised its full-year outlook after posting record quarterly revenue, record adjusted EBITDA and its highest-ever consolidated margin. A large emergency response job in Los Angeles contributed about $120 million in revenue during the quarter.

recent_news.headline: Biogas Digester Design in 2026: Engineering Guide for Industrial Wastewater
recent_news.summary: Engineering guide for 2026 biogas digester design covering FOG (fats, oils and grease) treatment, pre-treatment requirements via DAF, and pH control strategies for high-FOG industrial wastewater streams including grease trap waste to optimize biogas production.

backfill_news.headline: North Dakota adopts permanent septic system rules
backfill_news.summary: North Dakota finalized permanent rules for on-site wastewater treatment systems (septic systems) effective October 1, 2026, establishing statewide licensing requirements and a common technical code. This regulatory shift impacts septage haulers and installers.
